newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Council of Economic Planning and Development completes draft on national land development.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Interior Ministry completes review of draft on land registration.
Taiwan agrees to resume South Korean car imports.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - South Korean cars expected to resume entering Taiwan with annual 7,000-unit quota starting 1997.
Ruling Nationalist Party plans to aggressively enter telecommunication market for investment.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Local Taichung and Chiayi counties breach government debt limits.
Finance Ministry plans to ban farmers' associations from extending loans to institutions.
